items.title: docs(static): fix route path in serveStatic example to match root access
items.body:
Fixes #1578.

In `docs/4.examples/serve-static-assets.md`, the text explains:

> Now, create a `index.html` file in the `public` directory with a simple message and open your browser to http://localhost:3000. You should see the message.

Mounting the handler under `app.use("/public/**", ...)` causes:
1. Requests to `http://localhost:3000` return a 404 because they do not match `/public/**`.
2. Even when requesting `http://localhost:3000/public/index.html`, `id` is passed as `/public/index.html`, and `path.join("public", id)` resolves to `public/public/index.html`.

Updating the route path in the code examples to `app.use("/**", ...)` aligns the example with the documented instructions and the test patterns in `test/static.test.ts`.

items.title: fix(static): normalize index path join in idSearchPaths
items.body:
### Summary

Fixes #1584.

In `serveStatic`, `idSearchPaths` previously concatenated `${id}${suffix}` directly.
- For root requests (`GET /`, where `withoutTrailingSlash` normalizes `id` to `"/"`), the default `indexNames: ["/index.html"]`, produced `"//index.html"`. Looking up `"//index.html"` in backends keyed by canonical paths fails and returns 404.
- For applications configuring relative index names (e.g. `indexNames: ["index.html"]`), subfolder lookups like `GET /docs` produced `"/docsindex.html"` due to the missing slash.

### Solution

Normalize the join between `id` and `suffix` in `idSearchPaths`: strip leading slashes from `suffix` when non-empty, and join with a single slash boundary (`/${cleanSuffix}` when `id === "/"`, or `${id}/${cleanSuffix}` otherwise).

### Tests

- Added tests in `test/static.test.ts` verifying root lookup with default index names returns `/index.html` without double slashes, and relative index names on subfolders resolve correctly to `/sub-static/docs/index.html`.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Fixed static file index path resolution so leading slashes in index names do not create malformed paths. Relative index names now resolve correctly at the root and in nested folders.
